thread:
Alex: Quick quarter OKR check — short status from each owner. TL;DR: Search-routing shipped, Embeddings v2 slipped one week, Dedicated capacity needed for spike. Owners: @Priya (search), @Miguel (infra), @Lena (qa), @Ravi (ux).

Priya: shipped the search-routing PR yesterday, rolled to canary. 95% low-latency on nightly traces. sending perf graphs shortly. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Priya: embedding ingest still blocked on the data schema change from payments, that plus a flaky transform job. not done yet.

Sam: infra heads-up — we have a PV quota limit hit in staging that can break the embed pipeline. I can bump quotas but need approval for ephemeral storage increase.

Miguel: I can provision a short-lived volume increase (2TB) for staging. ETA 2h once approved. Also, Dedicated capacity request: need a GPU pool reserved this month for load test on 3/14.

Claire: approve the staging quota bump for test only. @Sam please coordinate with @Miguel for cleanup after tests.

Alex: approved. Sam/Miguel please add cleanup TTL.

Sam: will run `kubectl patch pvc embed-temp -p '{"metadata":{"annotations":{"ttl":"6h"}}}'` after bump, thanks.

Lena: QA note — embedding ingest tests are flaky around batch boundary. repro: intermittent 502s from transform-worker when batch size >= 64. Adding a flaky test ticket: #QA-812.

Priya: thanks, @Lena. I can add a guard to drop oversized batches and emit a metric `embed.batch.dropped`. Quick patch today.

Ravi: UX check — Search-routing shipped but a small UX regression: filter chips stack on mobile. I can do a 30m fix; want a quick canary with the patch.

Priya: happy to take a tiny frontend patch. Can you open a PR and ping me? I can merge and roll to canary.

Alex: Ownership clarifications: Priya owns the Search + Embeds rollout, Miguel owns infra capacity & Dedicated request, Claire owns coordination for cutover, Lena owns test acceptance. Action list below.

Claire: Action list (owners):
- Priya: ship embed guard + open PR for UX chip fix (ETA EOD)
- Miguel: provision staging volume and reserve Dedicated pool for 3/14 load test (ETA 2h / reserve by EOD)
- Sam: bump PV quotas, add TTL cleanup (after Miguel)
- Lena: run full embed acceptance tests once guard is in (ETA next morning)
- Alex: hold canary review + confirm rollback plan

Miguel: reserve noted. I'll open a short ticket with anticipated cost and pool size: `dedicated-pool/3-14-loadtest`.

Priya: opened PR for embed guard: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4821> — small change in `ingest/worker.go`.

Priya: also opened UI PR for chip wrap: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/frontend/pull/719> — CC @Ravi for visual review.

Ravi: reviewing UI PR now, small tweak suggested inline.

Lena: added flaky test repro logs to #QA-812, will re-run once the guard is merged.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for commit `pr/4821` on cluster `canary-west-2` at 2024-03-11T14:22:10Z.

Priya: canary looks good for search-routing (latency stable). embedding guard didn't trigger in canary data, will validate in staging after PV bump.

Alex: Good progress. If embedding slips beyond 3/14 we fallback to embeddings v1 + routing-only rollout. Please escalate any risks by EOD. :mailbox_with_mail:

Claire: I'll follow up in the morning with a status summary for the exec sync. Thanks, team.

Priya: quick call if needed — I'm free at 16:00 PST.

Sam: done with PV bump and TTL annotation applied. Miguel, confirm volume resize finished?

Miguel: volume increase complete, Dedicated pool reserved (ticket `dedicated-pool/3-14-loadtest`).

Lena: started acceptance run — currently at 60% through, will post final pass/fail.

Alex: leaving notes here so execs can read async. please keep updates short. :white_check_mark:
